fields.Name: Collaboration Home Invitations
fields.Description: The invitations waiting on an owner across every space a person reaches, newest first, up to 50: the rows behind the Awaiting Approval count of Collaboration Home Counts, with the same rules. Only the Integration role may run it: the server runs it as the system user, with the signed-in person's own id, through GetHomeLists.
fields.SQL:
SELECT TOP 50
    m.ID AS SeatID,
    m.SpaceID,
    s.Name AS SpaceName,
    COALESCE(u.Name, u.Email) AS Person,
    r.Name AS RoleName,
    m.__mj_CreatedAt AS InvitedAt
FROM [__mj_BizAppsCollaboration].[SpaceMember] m
INNER JOIN [__mj_BizAppsCollaboration].[fnCollaborationAccess]({{ UserID | sqlString }}) a ON a.SpaceID = m.SpaceID
INNER JOIN [__mj_BizAppsCollaboration].[Space] s ON s.ID = m.SpaceID
LEFT JOIN [__mj].[User] u ON u.ID = m.UserID
LEFT JOIN [__mj_BizAppsCollaboration].[SpaceRoleType] r ON r.ID = m.SpaceRoleTypeID
WHERE m.Status = N'Invited'
  AND a.CanInvite = 1
  AND m.UserID <> TRY_CAST({{ UserID | sqlString }} AS UNIQUEIDENTIFIER)
ORDER BY m.__mj_CreatedAt DESC
